qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the transmission extension (1AZ) on all models?
What size screw is used for the guard (2AZ) component?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 screw with 9 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: How much torque should be applied to the converter bell housing on 4HP-22/4HP-24 models?
qa_pairs.answer: 46 Nm using an M10 screw for 4HP-22/4HP-24 models.
